program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let ((objs (objects g 0)))
           (reduce (lambda (acc obj)
                     (let* ((rs (map fst (obj-cells obj)))
                            (cs (map snd (obj-cells obj)))
                            (r0 (min-list rs))
                            (c0 (min-list cs))
                            (r1 (max-list rs))
                            (c1 (max-list cs))
                            (oh (+ (- r1 r0) 1))
                            (ow (+ (- c1 c0) 1))
                            (mask (grid-from-fn oh
                                                ow
                                                (lambda (r c)
                                                  (if (= (at g (+ r r0) (+ c c0)) 8)
                                                      1
                                                      0))))
                            (filled (fill-all-enclosed mask 2 0))
                            (n-regions (length (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2))
                                                       (objects filled 0))))
                            (color (cond
                                     ((= n-regions 1) 1)
                                     ((= n-regions 2) 3)
                                     ((= n-regions 3) 2)
                                     ((= n-regions 4) 4)
                                     (else 8))))
                       (reduce (lambda (a cell)
                                 (set-cell a (fst cell) (snd cell) color))
                               acc
                               (obj-cells obj))))
                   g
                   objs))))
